forecasts.name: Climate Pessimist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: A super El Niño (+2.16) is hammering key tropical growing zones. The recent dip is a temporary calm before climate-driven supply shocks resume.

forecasts.name: Land-Grab Realist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: A raging El Niño (+2.16) threatens global robusta belts. Roasters face depleted physical reserves as origin states prioritize long-term bilateral arrangements.

forecasts.name: BirdLife Europe, EEB, WWF and Greenpeace (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Intensifying El Niño and tropical climate disruptions heighten crop risks, increasing volatility in coffee supplies.

forecasts.name: Macro / Dollar · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Softs are supported by the broader macro cycle; speculative capital could easily spark another rally toward 363 USc/lb by early 2027.

forecasts.name: FAO (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Easing farmgate prices and improved shipments from Vietnam suggest supply tightness is moderating, capping upside for early 2027.

forecasts.name: Crowd Follower · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: The crowd is at 27%. Recent news and monthly price action show noticeable declines in coffee, justifying a mild lean below the crowd.

forecasts.name: IMF (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Easing Vietnamese farmgate prices and roaster margin compression curb upside, despite macroeconomic supply chain vulnerabilities.

forecasts.name: Copa-Cogeca (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Easing Vietnamese farmgate prices and roaster margin squeezes limit upside momentum, despite lingering El Niño climatic uncertainties.

forecasts.name: IFPRI (Joseph Glauber) (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Sharp declines in Vietnamese farmgate prices and recovering robusta trade flows reduce pressure on EU roasters, limiting upside past 363 USc/lb.

forecasts.name: Geopolitics Hawk · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Vietnam harvest flows are rebounding and farmgate prices are declining. Softs lack the geopolitical chokepoint premium of grains.

forecasts.name: European Commission DG AGRI (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Easing robusta farmgate quotes and rebounding harvest flows in Southeast Asia relieve import cost pressures.

forecasts.name: USDA WASDE (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Falling farmgate prices in Vietnam indicate improving robusta availability, dampening the case for a renewed rally above 363 USc/lb.

forecasts.name: Scott Irwin (farmdoc) (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Recent price drops in Southeast Asia show supply responding to earlier highs. Big bullish narratives in coffee typically fade.

forecasts.name: Agronomist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Vietnam's robusta harvest floods export channels from late autumn into winter. Incoming beans will suppress European import costs, hindering a move above 363 USc/lb.

forecasts.name: Efficient-Market Skeptic · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Coffee is already deflating from its peaks as supply catches up. Expecting a renewed surge above 363 USc/lb ignores standard cyclical cooling.

forecasts.name: Adaptation Optimist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Vietnamese farmgate prices are plunging as record harvests and expanding robusta acreage counter earlier doom narratives.
